tagline_en: Firms and revives youthful, brighter eyes
tagline_zh: 高效抗老精华 · 焕亮年轻眼周
overview_en: An eye sérum step (used after toner, before eye crème) that firms, nourishes and revitalises the delicate eye area — smoothing signs of ageing, brightening dullness and firming for youthful, resilient eyes in as little as 10 days.
overview_zh: 眼部EGF精华，用于爽肤水后、眼霜前，润泽滋养娇嫩眼周，抚平老化痕迹、焕亮暗沉、紧致眼周，短短10天即可拥有年轻有活力的双眼。
benefits_zh: 紧致平滑，抚平老化痕迹
how_to_use_en: Apply after toner as the second step of your routine, before eye crème.
how_to_use_zh: 爽肤水后使用（护肤第二步），眼霜之前
